source: User instruction: malformed or missing row is worst case (error and block); do not repeat a run for one malformed row.
scoring_policy: Do not repair or substitute malformed rows. Claude scores them as worst case (error and block) using the sealed scorer. Orchestrator does not score.
rerun_policy: Repeat only if most cases are absent or the process fails; preserve every attempt and identify each one.
